tool_config.description: Propose adding one vehicle. Returns kind confirmation_ready with a readback to speak verbatim, or kind rejected. Required body fields are vin and effective_date.

vin.description: 17-character VIN exactly as the caller stated it. Never pad or repair.

effective_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD supplied by the caller. Never substitute a date.
